# TRACE_INGEST

Where traces are sent and queried.

<!-- Generated by nix/signature-docs.nix from nix build .#referencePages -->

Canonically `traces`. A floe providing this must declare it
as `provides.traces`; a hole that resolves it may be called
anything.
